Swagger._comment: Enabled is null here, which means Development only. Set Swagger__Enabled=true to publish the Swagger UI on another host; it is then served ONLY behind HTTP Basic auth, and answers 503 until Swagger__Auth__Password is set. Never put the password in this file.

DefaultTenant._comment: Tenant provisioned at start-up by TenantSeeder. Fqdn is the FRONT-END'S ORIGIN, scheme included (https://crm.example.com): clients stamp every call with location.origin and the lookup matches that string whole, so a bare host is never found. Empty on purpose - set DefaultTenant__Fqdn and DefaultTenant__RootUserEmail from the environment. Pin DefaultTenant__Id in any deployment that keeps data: every row of the API's database is keyed by it, and a registry rebuilt without it generates a new one.
DefaultTenant.Name: Sankore

AdminJwt._comment: Platform operators' tokens. NOT Sankore.Api's Jwt section: own key, own issuer and audience, so a tenant token never opens the registry. SigningKey is required (32+ bytes) and the host refuses to start without it - set AdminJwt__SigningKey from the environment, never here.

Cors._comment: Origins of the admin front-end, scheme included. Empty outside Development means the browser blocks it (a warning is logged). '*' is refused at boot.

PlatformAdmin._comment: First platform administrator, created ONLY when the table is empty; an existing account is never touched. Set PlatformAdmin__Email and PlatformAdmin__Password from the environment for the first boot, then remove the password.
